original.statement: The `--registry` CLI flag for specifying a default package registry has been removed; all packages must now use fully qualified names including the registry host name.

decision.reason: [ev-430fc91e4c1d] says, under "Removed features", "**Removed**: `--registry` flag for default package registry". So the subject is the cli-flag `--registry`, and the change type is "removed". The text names no specific component other than the product itself, so leaving out the component field is correct. The validators returned inconclusive, which neither supports nor contradicts this reading.
